Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly will my listing go live?

Sponsored and Premium listings go live within 24-48 hours after payment confirmation.

Do I need a contract?

No. All plans are month-to-month. Cancel any time with 7 days notice.

Can I update my listing?

Yes! Email us any time to update hours, photos, menu info, or GF protocols.

What if I'm already listed for free?

You can upgrade your free listing to Sponsored or Premium at any time — we'll update it immediately.

How do you verify GF options?

We research each restaurant's menu, policies, and training. Sponsored partners get a detailed intake form and we publish exactly what you tell us.

Do you offer annual discounts?

Yes — pay annually and save 2 months (equivalent to ~17% off). Ask us about annual pricing in your message.
